summary: legal checked in 7 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked. Keep SearchWoot private and preview-only; do not authorize public beta, full launch, alert expansion, affiliate/advertising expansion, or external rights outreach. Evidence: Woot documentation establishes API access but not redistribution, storage, historical derivatives, public display, alerts, images, prices, attribution, freshness, correction, or takedown rights; current public terms point against the proposed commercial/public data use. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, owner, and jurisdictional privacy gates also remain incomplete. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and any affiliate or advertising use. This is risk triage, not legal advice or certification.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active. No checklist task is closed because direct completion evidence is absent. Progress: the legal/data-rights packet and Slack integration audit requests are verified, but the four authoritative launch-readiness tasks remain open. Next evidence action: attach a single dated consolidated evidence bundle covering source rights, data flow and retention, deployed consent and GA4 configuration, and logs/vendors/incident handling.

Data-use review dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked pending authoritative permission; user alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; GA4 is conditional for measurement-only use after explicit consent; operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed for operational use only. No display, alerting, affiliate, advertising, remarketing, or secondary monetization use is cleared by this review.

Fleet compliance is a technical baseline, not certification: 35 sites pass, 18 fail, and 6 are unknown; open findings include banner, accept/reject controls, GA4, privacy, and terms. Analytics is configured and healthy for the measured live cohort, while revenue attribution is partial because the provider aggregate row is not assignable to a site. Do not block ordinary reversible growth solely for incomplete telemetry, but preserve existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Security-sensitive releases and new public exposure remain blocked while security evidence is unavailable.

Private-site decision: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. Evidence: readiness packets are incomplete; complicated.work has no configured analytics and compliance reachability is unknown; fleet security evidence remains incomplete. Next evidence action: attach one dated readiness packet per site covering ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blockers. No publish, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue admission is cleared.

Containment-only execution remains appropriate. Active delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, with 54 improvements measuring, 21 failed requests, and 7 repair follow-ups open. Retain the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement as slot-gated only; do not admit it until the existing saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case is completed or justifiably closed, one slot is released, and overlap is rechecked. The proposed CTA may proceed conditionally only with disclosure preservation, registered tracking ID, link integrity, accessibility, build/smoke validation, baseline capture, measurement limits, and single-diff rollback.

No go-live proposal is supported. Therefore no implementation.launch_gate=go_live or legal_review.status=approved is issued. Any future go-live submission must include direct compliance, rights/provenance, privacy/consent, terms, analytics disclosure, affiliate disclosure, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, age-sensitive, security, accuracy, measurement, and owner-decision evidence.
